mapper.sql: p.profile_id AS profileId, p.user_id AS userId, u.nickname, u.email, p.display_name AS displayName, p.short_intro AS shortIntro, p.detail_intro AS detailIntro, CASE WHEN p.profile_image_path IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT('/api/media/images/profile/', p.profile_id) ELSE NULL END AS profileImageUrl, p.visibility, p.activity_status AS activityStatus, p.region_id AS regionId, rg.public_display_name AS publicRegionName, rg.sido_name AS sidoName, rg.sigungu_name AS sigunguName, rg.dong_name AS dongName, rg.center_lat AS centerLat, rg.center_lng AS centerLng, p.experience_level AS experienceLevel, p.join_availability AS joinAvailability, p.collaboration_status AS collaborationStatus, p.travel_range AS travelRange, p.preferred_duration AS preferredDuration, p.equipment_status AS equipmentStatus, p.age_band AS ageBand, p.participation_mode AS participationMode, p.profile_completed_yn AS profileCompletedYn, p.status, p.last_active_at AS lastActiveAt, p.created_at AS createdAt, p.updated_at AS updatedAt, p.deleted_at AS deletedAt
mapper.select: SELECT FROM member_profile p JOIN user_account u ON u.user_id = p.user_id JOIN region rg ON rg.region_id = p.region_id WHERE p.user_id = #{userId} AND p.status = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT FROM member_profile p JOIN user_account u ON u.user_id = p.user_id JOIN region rg ON rg.region_id = p.region_id WHERE p.user_id = #{userId}
SELECT FROM member_profile p JOIN user_account u ON u.user_id = p.user_id JOIN region rg ON rg.region_id = p.region_id WHERE p.profile_id = #{profileId} AND p.status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT FROM member_profile p JOIN user_account u ON u.user_id = p.user_id JOIN region rg ON rg.region_id = p.region_id WHERE p.profile_id = #{profileId} AND p.status = 'ACTIVE' AND p.visibility = 'PUBLIC' AND p.profile_completed_yn = 'Y' AND p.activity_status = 'VISIBLE' AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND u.account_type = 'USER' AND u.account_status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT r.role_id AS roleId, r.name AS roleName, rc.role_category_id AS roleCategoryId, rc.name AS roleCategoryName, pr.sort_order AS sortOrder FROM profile_role pr JOIN `role` r ON r.role_id = pr.role_id JOIN role_category rc ON rc.role_category_id = r.role_category_id WHERE pr.profile_id = #{profileId} ORDER BY pr.sort_order, rc.sort_order, r.sort_order
SELECT g.genre_id AS genreId, g.name FROM profile_genre pg JOIN genre g ON g.genre_id = pg.genre_id WHERE pg.profile_id = #{profileId} ORDER BY g.sort_order

SELECT pcc.condition_code AS conditionCode, COALESCE(c.display_name, pcc.condition_code) AS displayName FROM profile_collaboration_condition pcc LEFT JOIN common_code c ON c.code_group = 'COLLABORATION_CONDITION' AND c.code = pcc.condition_code WHERE pcc.profile_id = #{profileId} ORDER BY c.sort_order, pcc.condition_code

SELECT pi.portfolio_item_id AS portfolioItemId, pi.profile_id AS profileId, pi.public_data_sync_item_id AS publicDataSyncItemId, pi.title, pi.role_name AS roleName, pi.credit_name AS creditName, pi.description, pi.source_type AS sourceType, pi.external_source_name AS externalSourceName, pi.external_reference_id AS externalReferenceId, pi.url, pi.thumbnail_url AS thumbnailUrl, CASE WHEN pi.thumbnail_image_path IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT('/api/media/images/portfolio/', pi.portfolio_item_id) ELSE NULL END AS uploadedThumbnailUrl, pi.sort_order AS sortOrder, pi.status, pi.created_at AS createdAt, pi.updated_at AS updatedAt, CASE WHEN pv.verification_status = 'VERIFIED' THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS verified, pv.verification_status AS verificationStatus, pv.provider, pv.provider_movie_code AS providerMovieCode, pv.provider_movie_title AS providerMovieTitle, pv.provider_movie_title_en AS providerMovieTitleEn, pv.provider_movie_year AS providerMovieYear, pv.provider_open_date AS providerOpenDate, pv.provider_genres AS providerGenres, pv.provider_person_name AS providerPersonName, pv.provider_person_name_en AS providerPersonNameEn, pv.provider_role_name AS providerRoleName, pv.provider_role_name AS matchedRoleName, pv.matched_role_group AS matchedRoleGroup, pv.matched_source AS matchedSource FROM portfolio_item pi LEFT JOIN portfolio_verification pv ON pv.portfolio_item_id = pi.portfolio_item_id WHERE pi.profile_id = #{profileId} AND pi.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY pi.sort_order ASC, pi.created_at DESC

SELECT pi.portfolio_item_id AS portfolioItemId, pi.profile_id AS profileId, pi.public_data_sync_item_id AS publicDataSyncItemId, pi.title, pi.role_name AS roleName, pi.credit_name AS creditName, pi.description, pi.source_type AS sourceType, pi.external_source_name AS externalSourceName, pi.external_reference_id AS externalReferenceId, pi.url, pi.thumbnail_url AS thumbnailUrl, CASE WHEN pi.thumbnail_image_path IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT('/api/media/images/portfolio/', pi.portfolio_item_id) ELSE NULL END AS uploadedThumbnailUrl, pi.sort_order AS sortOrder, pi.status, pi.created_at AS createdAt, pi.updated_at AS updatedAt, CASE WHEN pv.verification_status = 'VERIFIED' THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS verified, pv.verification_status AS verificationStatus, pv.provider, pv.provider_movie_code AS providerMovieCode, pv.provider_movie_title AS providerMovieTitle, pv.provider_movie_title_en AS providerMovieTitleEn, pv.provider_movie_year AS providerMovieYear, pv.provider_open_date AS providerOpenDate, pv.provider_genres AS providerGenres, pv.provider_person_name AS providerPersonName, pv.provider_person_name_en AS providerPersonNameEn, pv.provider_role_name AS providerRoleName, pv.provider_role_name AS matchedRoleName, pv.matched_role_group AS matchedRoleGroup, pv.matched_source AS matchedSource FROM portfolio_item pi LEFT JOIN portfolio_verification pv ON pv.portfolio_item_id = pi.portfolio_item_id WHERE pi.portfolio_item_id = #{portfolioItemId}

SELECT pi.portfolio_item_id AS portfolioItemId, pi.profile_id AS profileId, pi.public_data_sync_item_id AS publicDataSyncItemId, pi.title, pi.role_name AS roleName, pi.credit_name AS creditName, pi.description, pi.source_type AS sourceType, pi.external_source_name AS externalSourceName, pi.external_reference_id AS externalReferenceId, pi.url, pi.thumbnail_url AS thumbnailUrl, CASE WHEN pi.thumbnail_image_path IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT('/api/media/images/portfolio/', pi.portfolio_item_id) ELSE NULL END AS uploadedThumbnailUrl, pi.sort_order AS sortOrder, pi.status, pi.created_at AS createdAt, pi.updated_at AS updatedAt, CASE WHEN pv.verification_status = 'VERIFIED' THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS verified, pv.verification_status AS verificationStatus, pv.provider, pv.provider_movie_code AS providerMovieCode, pv.provider_movie_title AS providerMovieTitle, pv.provider_movie_title_en AS providerMovieTitleEn, pv.provider_movie_year AS providerMovieYear, pv.provider_open_date AS providerOpenDate, pv.provider_genres AS providerGenres, pv.provider_person_name AS providerPersonName, pv.provider_person_name_en AS providerPersonNameEn, pv.provider_role_name AS providerRoleName, pv.provider_role_name AS matchedRoleName, pv.matched_role_group AS matchedRoleGroup, pv.matched_source AS matchedSource FROM portfolio_item pi LEFT JOIN portfolio_verification pv ON pv.portfolio_item_id = pi.portfolio_item_id JOIN member_profile p ON p.profile_id = pi.profile_id WHERE pi.portfolio_item_id = #{portfolioItemId} AND p.user_id = #{userId} AND pi.status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT verification_id AS verificationId, portfolio_item_id AS portfolioItemId, provider, provider_movie_code AS providerMovieCode, provider_movie_title AS providerMovieTitle, provider_movie_title_en AS providerMovieTitleEn, provider_movie_year AS providerMovieYear, provider_open_date AS providerOpenDate, provider_genres AS providerGenres, provider_person_name AS providerPersonName, provider_person_name_en AS providerPersonNameEn, provider_role_name AS providerRoleName, matched_role_group AS matchedRoleGroup, matched_source AS matchedSource, verification_status AS verificationStatus, raw_response_json AS rawResponseJson, checked_at AS checkedAt, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM portfolio_verification WHERE portfolio_item_id = #{portfolioItemId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM portfolio_item WHERE profile_id = #{profileId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT public_data_sync_item_id AS publicDataSyncItemId, source_name AS sourceName, item_type AS itemType, external_id AS externalId, title, description, provider_url AS providerUrl, display_year AS displayYear, creator_name AS creatorName, raw_json AS rawJson, synced_at AS syncedAt FROM public_data_sync_item WHERE public_data_sync_item_id = #{publicDataSyncItemId} AND active_yn = 'Y'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO member_profile ( user_id, display_name, short_intro, detail_intro, visibility, activity_status, region_id, experience_level, join_availability, collaboration_status, travel_range, preferred_duration, equipment_status, age_band, participation_mode, profile_completed_yn, last_active_at, created_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{displayName}, #{shortIntro}, #{detailIntro}, #{visibility}, #{activityStatus}, #{regionId}, #{experienceLevel}, #{joinAvailability}, #{collaborationStatus}, #{travelRange}, #{preferredDuration}, #{equipmentStatus}, #{ageBand}, #{participationMode}, #{profileCompletedYn}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE member_profile SET display_name = #{displayName}, short_intro = #{shortIntro}, detail_intro = #{detailIntro}, visibility = #{visibility}, activity_status = #{activityStatus}, region_id = #{regionId}, experience_level = #{experienceLevel}, join_availability = #{joinAvailability}, collaboration_status = #{collaborationStatus}, travel_range = #{travelRange}, preferred_duration = #{preferredDuration}, equipment_status = #{equipmentStatus}, age_band = #{ageBand}, participation_mode = #{participationMode}, profile_completed_yn = #{profileCompletedYn}, status = 'ACTIVE', last_active_at = NOW(), deleted_at = NULL, updated_at = NOW() WHERE profile_id = #{profileId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'

UPDATE member_profile SET display_name = #{displayName}, short_intro = #{shortIntro}, detail_intro = #{detailIntro}, visibility = #{visibility}, activity_status = #{activityStatus}, region_id = #{regionId}, experience_level = #{experienceLevel}, join_availability = #{joinAvailability}, collaboration_status = #{collaborationStatus}, travel_range = #{travelRange}, preferred_duration = #{preferredDuration}, equipment_status = #{equipmentStatus}, age_band = #{ageBand}, participation_mode = #{participationMode}, profile_completed_yn = #{profileCompletedYn}, status = 'ACTIVE', last_active_at = NOW(), deleted_at = NULL, updated_at = NOW() WHERE profile_id = #{profileId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'DELETED'

mapper.update: UPDATE portfolio_item SET public_data_sync_item_id = #{publicDataSyncItemId}, title = #{title}, role_name = #{roleName}, credit_name = #{creditName}, description = #{description}, source_type = #{sourceType}, external_source_name = #{externalSourceName}, external_reference_id = #{externalReferenceId}, url = #{url}, thumbnail_url = #{thumbnailUrl}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE portfolio_item_id = #{portfolioItemId} AND profile_id = #{profileId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'

UPDATE portfolio_item pi JOIN member_profile p ON p.profile_id = pi.profile_id SET pi.status = 'DELETED', pi.deleted_at = NOW(), pi.updated_at = NOW() WHERE pi.portfolio_item_id = #{portfolioItemId} AND p.user_id = #{userId} AND pi.status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO portfolio_verification ( portfolio_item_id, provider, provider_movie_code, provider_movie_title, provider_movie_title_en, provider_movie_year, provider_open_date, provider_genres, provider_person_name, provider_person_name_en, provider_role_name, matched_role_group, matched_source, verification_status, raw_response_json, checked_at, created_at ) VALUES ( #{portfolioItemId}, #{provider}, #{providerMovieCode}, #{providerMovieTitle}, #{providerMovieTitleEn}, #{providerMovieYear}, #{providerOpenDate}, #{providerGenres}, #{providerPersonName}, #{providerPersonNameEn}, #{providerRoleName}, #{matchedRoleGroup}, #{matchedSource}, #{verificationStatus}, #{rawResponseJson}, NOW(), NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE provider = VALUES(provider), provider_movie_code = VALUES(provider_movie_code), provider_movie_title = VALUES(provider_movie_title), provider_movie_title_en = VALUES(provider_movie_title_en), provider_movie_year = VALUES(provider_movie_year), provider_open_date = VALUES(provider_open_date), provider_genres = VALUES(provider_genres), provider_person_name = VALUES(provider_person_name), provider_person_name_en = VALUES(provider_person_name_en), provider_role_name = VALUES(provider_role_name), matched_role_group = VALUES(matched_role_group), matched_source = VALUES(matched_source), verification_status = VALUES(verification_status), raw_response_json = VALUES(raw_response_json), checked_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW()
